_comment: Craft app CLIs bundled into the Studio image. Only list an app here after checking by hand that its --automation-read-root/--automation-write-root flags refuse every path outside the root (absolute paths, ../, and symlinks), because Studio runs one copy per signed-in user on a shared server. Also hide tools that need the desktop app or reach outside the session (printing, OS keychains, script consoles), and list in blocked_commands any engine command the generic command tools could reach that does (network sharing, plug-ins). Some apps accept the flags without enforcing them, so test before adding; never add an app because its --help lists the flags. sha256 values are the release's linux tarballs, copied from its SHA256SUMS.txt.
